title: Offbeat Street Art Tour of Chicago: Urban Graffiti, Art, and Murals
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers should be healthy enough to walk 2 miles in 2 hours.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Offbeat Street Art Tour is the first tour in Chicago that truly celebrates Chicago's street art scene. No other tour takes guests out into the streets to showcase and highlight the vibrant street art scene which many people overlook on a daily basis. We hope you join us to experience something truly unique in Chicago.
